description: Legacy Baton Rouge Traffic Incidents (2021 - 2022) is a dataset listed in City of Baton Rouge open data portal (data.brla.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Baton Rouge. On August 30, 2022, the Baton Rouge Police Department switched to a new crash reporting system. This dataset contains data from 1/1/2021 to 8/29/2022. Coverage: Baton Rouge. The portal files it under the category Public Safety. Its tags are traffic, brpd, crash. The table has 36 columns. Attribution on the portal: Baton Rouge Police Department. The portal shows 2025-07-02 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-brla-gov-portal.
